gaps.next_text: All our enemies have fallen before us.

cues.text: Five white swords on a red background become light beams radiating behind a monumental white building.
Cables connect his bare torso to glowing machinery. He clenches his fist. Everything fades to black.

beats.note: Five white stylized swords point upward against a deep red background.
The swords become light rays behind a large, classical white building as the perspective widens.
A figure in a black coat stands on the building's balcony, overlooking a vast, orderly crowd of red silhouettes.
Banners bearing a symbol drop down between the building's columns.
Two large, shadowed figures appear on the balcony, flanking the central figure.
White petals begin to fall across the red and white scene.
The central figure raises a clenched fist to his chest.
The stylized scene glitches violently, revealing a realistic, dimly lit laboratory.
The emperor stands bare-chested in the lab. Black cables run from a glowing, circular machine directly into his chest and arms.
Three scientists in white lab coats stand around him, observing.
Golden energy ripples over the emperor's skin.
The emperor clenches his fist, looking down at it.
